description: Verify that DUT client restarts refused TCP connection on next OfferService
approach:
[Objective]
Client recovery: a refused TCP connection must be retried on the next OfferService — DUT does not give up permanently.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. DUT → Tester: Subscribe with TCP option.
3. Tester refuses TCP handshake.
4. Tester → DUT: another OfferService.
5. Observation: DUT completes TCP handshake.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT retried TCP after refusal — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_subscribe_with_tcp_option: No DUT Subscribe with TCP option within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_tcp_handshake_after_secon: DUT did not complete TCP handshake after second offer
